title: High-Performance Computing
description: Design and optimization of high-performance algorithms and computing systems, focusing on parallel execution, scalability, computational efficiency, and performance optimization.

title: Parallel and Distributed Computing
description: Development of scalable parallel and distributed algorithms, emphasizing workload distribution, communication efficiency, synchronization, and efficient resource utilization.

title: GPU Computing and Parallel Graph Algorithms
description: Design and optimization of GPU-accelerated graph algorithms, with a focus on maximum-flow computation, efficient graph representations, CUDA programming, and memory-efficient parallel processing.

title: Heterogeneous Computing Systems
description: Performance optimization across heterogeneous CPU–GPU and ARM–GPU architectures, focusing on workload partitioning, computational efficiency, and coordinated execution.

title: Resource Management and Workload Scheduling
description: Development of communication-aware and performance-driven scheduling strategies for heterogeneous computing environments, emphasizing load balancing, resource utilization, and execution efficiency.

title: High-Performance Nanopore Basecalling
description: Performance characterization and optimization of nanopore sequencing basecalling workflows using parallel processing, heterogeneous computing, and distributed workload scheduling.

title: Energy-Efficient Computing
description: Analysis and optimization of execution time, power consumption, and energy efficiency in GPU-accelerated algorithms and heterogeneous computing systems.

title: Algorithm Engineering and Performance Analysis
description: Bridging theoretical algorithm design with practical implementation through performance profiling, experimental evaluation, and architecture-aware optimization.
